_comment: Prompt for EnrichClientWorker (in-process ENRICH_CLIENT, one call per source summary). Placeholders: {trade}; {client} = compact identity JSON; {dossierTail}; {url}; {summary} = the source snippet; {today} = ISO date; {containerLine} = containerVendorRule below when the client came from a container event, else empty. Output contract: STRICT JSON {"lines":[...],"email":null,"phone":null} -- code parses exactly that.
lines: Fold ONE source summary into the sales dossier of a prospect for a "{trade}" vendor.
DOSSIER TAIL (do not repeat facts already here): """{dossierTail}"""

Rules: lines are NEW dossier facts about THIS client only, taken from the SOURCE -- invent nothing, skip anything already in the dossier tail. Format each line as "[PERMANENT] <stable fact>" or "[{today}] time-sensitive signal from {url}: <buying occasion / event date / budget / trend>".
email/phone: ONLY if a direct, personal (non-generic, not info@/sales@) one appears VERBATIM in the SOURCE text; otherwise null.
No new facts -> {"lines":[],"email":null,"phone":null}. JSON only, no prose.
containerVendorRule: This client is a container-event vendor: if the SOURCE shows fit evidence for the vendor above (prior photo booth / caricature / live-entertainment use, crowd type that buys it), add a line "[PERMANENT] synergy: <specific evidence>". No evidence, no synergy line.
